title: Panda Adventure HUD configuration
description: Authoritative config for the S6a HUD blockout (gADR-0000, gADR-0004): the overlay's placement margin and the value-change pulse tween. The HUD's CONTENT (live HP/MP/EXP/Gold + Current weapon) is fixed by the GDD's 'HUD & UI' section; concrete layout/styling beyond these numbers is a later asset concern. Converted by scripts/build_config.py into the derived data/generated/hud_config.tres (HudConfig).

margin.description: Offset (x, y) in pixels of the HUD stat column from the viewport's top-left corner; each non-negative.

value_punch_scale.description: Scale punch applied to a HUD label the moment its value changes (the blockout 'juice' tween, recovering to 1.0); each component strictly positive.

value_tween_duration.description: Seconds for the value-change punch to recover to normal scale; strictly positive.
